_doc: T-106: thresholds and sample definitions of the Bay-scale M-005@v2 (research/R-100.md section 6, plans/M2.md Track 1). Thresholds are the R-100 / R-004 / R-020 values and are never lowered; a failing sub-measure is a finding. Boxes are (W, S, E, N) WGS84. A box without a sourced reference depth is `reported` (R-100: USACE project depths Assumed until sourced), never passed.
bay_polygon_note: R-004 section 6.3: lon -122.47 to -121.75, lat 37.40 to 38.20, excluding the Pacific (lat < 37.79 and lon < -122.42); includes diked cells below MSL in the reference, our water mask is OSM water AND below MSL
